messages:
nicole: quick idea: show an "Estimated units" hint in the console for embeddings before users hit the API. could cut down on 413 tickets and billing surprises
rajan: +1. we already have dims/byte heuristics at ingress. question: show bytes OR dims? both?
evelyn: runtime prefers dims for cost estimates; bytes for transport limits. recommend one-line with both: 'Est billing: 2.1k dims — Payload: 4.8 KB' and a suggested split button
sam: UX: keep primary line tiny, details dropdown with math and a curl example for chunking. avoid heavy terms in main UI
nicole: telemetry: emit embed_console.preflight_shown and embed_console.preflight_applied with dims,size,route_id,tenant_id so we can measure impact
rajan: implement as separate preflight endpoint /v1/embeddings/preflight (cheap, rate-limited). header X-Embed-Preflight: 1 to opt-in. return headers x-embed-hint: dims=2100;size=4800;split=4 or 200 with body if needed
evelyn: prefer separate endpoint vs adding work to main path. mark preflight non-billable and ensure estimator matches billing math. mixed-dim arrays should return "mixed" flag not single number
sam: console calls preflight when user pastes big array or toggles preview. add 'auto preflight' setting. show sample chunking snippet when mixed dims detected
nicole: rollout: UI behind flag, server flag for preflight. canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over a week. infra-bot: deploy job queued by rajan: canary embed-preflight rollout started (10%) :rocket:
rajan: i'll add server flag, endpoint, and rate-limits. evelyn: i'll add parity tests vs billing and splitter to keep suggestions consistent
sam: product wants per-route metric cards: % preflight shown, % applied, avg suggested splits. we'll emit metrics to support dashboards
nicole: action items: rajan = preflight endpoint + flags + telemetry hooks, evelyn = estimator parity + tests, sam = UI mock and settings toggle, nicole = telemetry spec + dashboard. sync tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
